title: Live Theater
content: Anyone else have a live theater in their mall world? Mine morphs a little depending but to enter the theater there are doors that wind through hall/tunnels to the rows of seats. These corridors are very steep and narrow. Inside the theater it is fairly non descript as far as age but there are big elegant red curtains and they are always shut. There are many back stage areas and some that are almost like attics where you go up ladders into square white painted rooms with single long florescent bulbs. In the rooms are various lights and wires and the like. One time there was an electrician there and he told me I shouldn't be there. If you keep going up you can access the roof but I have only done that once and something scared me either awake or back down inside (can't remember). Back down inside below the bright stoage rooms occasionally morphs into a big open old school type gym with a basketball court. Sometimes there are people in the audience. I am almost always either behind stage or up in the attic backrooms or behind the curtains on stage. Occasionally I will be looking in from the corridors to the seats and sometimes I will be in the lobby area where there are many people all milling around going into the doorways to find their seats. I have never once seen a play in my dreams though. Have you experienced anything like this? Were you on stage/backstage/etc? Do the storage rooms sound familiar?
